rationale: The snapshot has Notion/Obsidian tooling cards but none about export pain or lossy exports, so demand and competition cannot be judged. Hours (240 team-hours) would be ample, so the evidence gate is the deciding factor.

idea_text: A command-line tool that exports Notion and Obsidian notes to clean, portable Markdown with working links and images, because built-in exports are slow and lose structure.

idea_text: A small web app that pulls assignment due dates from a university learning platform and publishes them as one calendar feed, since students juggle deadlines across several course sites.
rationale: Only generic calendar-sync cards exist (Single Calendar, MeetingBar, Proton Calendar API); nothing on university learning platforms or deadline feeds, so fewer than 3 relevant sources.

idea_text: A GitHub app that posts a short plain-English summary of every pull request diff so reviewers know what to look at first.
rationale: PR Agent and Mira already generate PR summaries and walkthroughs, so the idea as stated duplicates visible products; Stack Exchange review threads show some pain but not for summaries specifically. A narrower angle (what to look at first) could be differentiated.

idea_text: A lightweight self-hosted uptime monitor for hobby projects: HTTP checks, a status page and alerts to chat, running on a 512 MB server.

idea_text: A browser extension that blocks distracting sites during study blocks and ends the block early only after a short typed reflection.
rationale: Adjacent cards on two platforms (a new-tab site blocker, several Pomodoro apps, a focus tracker) show interest and no tool with a typed-reflection exit, so there is a differentiator. Scope fits 40 hours, but the profile lists only Python while a browser extension needs JavaScript, and demand evidence is indirect.

idea_text: A dotfiles and dev-environment bootstrapper that sets up a new laptop for a programming course with one command and a checklist.

idea_text: A new general-purpose social network that replaces Instagram, with photo feeds, reels, messaging and ads.
rationale: A full Instagram replacement (feeds, reels, messaging, ads) cannot be built in 40 hours by one student, and it duplicates an entrenched product. Feasibility and duplicate gates both fail without needing KB evidence (note: the engine would report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE first if the KB has no cards).

idea_text: Real-time facial recognition across dormitory cameras to track where students are, without asking them.
rationale: Covert facial recognition tracking of students without consent is a legal and ethical blocker (privacy and biometric law). The risk blocker decides regardless of evidence (engine may report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE first because the KB has no cards).

idea_text: Train a new large language model from scratch to beat the best commercial assistants.
rationale: Training a frontier-competitive LLM from scratch needs orders of magnitude more compute and hours than 40 team-hours on a laptop; the only related card is a hobby-scale embedding model.

idea_text: Train a new large language model from scratch to beat the best commercial assistants.

idea_text: A cryptocurrency exchange that holds customer money and lets people trade with leverage.
rationale: Holding customer funds and offering leveraged trading triggers financial licensing and custody regulation that students cannot meet. Risk blocker decides (the KB has no related cards).

idea_text: A mapping service with worldwide street-level coverage and live traffic, replacing Google Maps.
rationale: Worldwide street-level maps with live traffic need data licensing and infrastructure far beyond 240 team-hours and duplicate Google Maps and OpenStreetMap; no related cards exist.

idea_text: A phone app that diagnoses diseases from photos and tells patients which prescription drugs to take.
rationale: Diagnosing disease from photos and recommending prescription drugs is a medical-liability and regulatory blocker (medical device and prescribing rules) regardless of team skill.
